title: It's a hard life
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
I don't want my freedom
There's no reason for living
With broken heart

[verse]
This is tricky situation
I've only got myself to blame
It's just simple fact of life,
it can happen to anyone.
You win, you lose, it's chance you have to take with love.
Oh yeah, I fell in love and now you say it's over,
and I'm falling apart...
Yes, It's long hard life
to be true lovers together.
To love and live for ever, in each others hearts.
It's long hard fight, to learn to care for each other,
to trust in one another right from the start
When you're in love...

[verse]
I try and mend the broken pieces
I try to fight back the tears
They say it's just state of mind

[bridge]
How it hurts (yeah) - deep inside (oh, yeah)
When your love has cut you down to size
Life is tough - on your own
Now I'm waiting for something to fall from the skies
I'm waiting for love
Ohhh, It's long hard life
to be true lovers together.
To love and live for ever, in each others hearts.
It's long hard fight, to learn to care for each other,
to trust in one another right from the start
When you're in love...
solo:
(parte do solo)

[bridge]
(2ª parte do solo)

[intro]

It's long hard fight

[bridge]

Final:
Yes, I did it for love
Yes, I did it for love
For love
Oh, I did it for love
